text:
Ana (PMM): Short thread to lock the benchmark hero and two visuals. Need: headline A/B, two captions (devs vs platform buyers), and final chart callouts. Keep language tight and testable.

Ravi (Data): I'll push the canonical numbers to Drive. For visuals I recommend: scatter (median latency ms on x, cost cents/1k on y) + a tail risk panel (p95/p99 lines). Use cents to avoid tiny decimals.

Tara (Design): On it. Visual treatment idea: muted background, teal accent for Redwood points, light grey for references. Scatter will include little badges: 'cache on' and 'quant'. Tail panel will show shaded SLA bands with thin red overlay for risk.

Hugo (Growth): Headline candidates: 1) "Predictable latency. Predictable cost." 2) "Benchmark the tradeoffs: speed vs spend." We'll A/B test them on the hero and email subject. Track CTR, demo signups, and form conversions.

Ivy (Product): Product blurb for subhead: "Dedicated capacity + smart routing cuts tail risk and lets you control unit economics." Keep <18 words. Also suggest a one-line methods footnote: GPU class, median over N requests, seq length range.

Ravi (Data): Small CSV snippet for mockups: ```
workload,variant,median_ms,p95_ms,cost_per_1k_cents,notes
chat,redwood-quant,40,170,1.1,baseline
chat,redwood-quant+cache,26,110,0.75,prefix cache
summarize,open-gt3,125,610,4.8,long sequences
embed,embed-lite,18,42,0.55,short tokens
```

Tara (Design): Thanks. I'll produce PNGs + an interactive hover for the web hero. Will annotate arrows: "cache -> latency down" and "batch -> cost down". Uploading assets when ready.

AssetBot: Assets uploaded to https://drive.redwood.dev/bench/1705012345 (scatter_final.png, tails_final.png, dataset.csv, methods.txt).

Hugo (Growth): I'll wire the UTMs and draft two subject lines for the email A/B: A) "See the latency vs cost tradeoffs" B) "How to lower unit cost without breaking SLAs".

Ana (PMM): Great. Action items: Ravi -> final CSV + methods; Tara -> two mocks + interactive; Hugo -> UTMs + email CTAs; Ivy -> one-sentence product fallback blurb. I'll compile the landing copy tonight and share for quick review tomorrow AM. This thread is canonical for benchmark hero and chart copy. :rocket:
